name: sidebar
title: Sidebar
description: The main navigation of an app: brand, sections with nested items and badges, a pinned footer, collapsible to icons.

when: Navigating an app with several sections.

instead.when: A public site with few pages.

builtIn: The current page is marked with aria-current.
Under 1024px it becomes a panel opened from the header.
Collapsed, the rail shows the logo and the account's avatar alone; the brand name stays the link's accessible name.
youProvide: With children: a unique id on every SidebarItem and SidebarSubmenu (currentKey matches it), or isCurrent on the page's item.

guidance.rule: Put the signed-in person in the footer with SidebarAccount (name, description, avatarSrc, items): a row that opens the account menu, and, collapsed, a square the size of a nav icon with the name as its tooltip, so sign-out stays reachable.

Sidebar.name: brand
Sidebar.description: The product name, after `logo` (or the logo and name together). It links to `brandHref`. Or a `SidebarHeader` child.

Sidebar.name: logo
Sidebar.description:
The app's mark (an Icon or an image) before `brand`. Collapsed, the rail shows it alone, centred; the
name stays the link's accessible name. Without it, collapsed shows the start of `brand`.

Sidebar.name: items
Sidebar.description:
The top-level items (links, or groups with `children`); five to eight is the comfortable range. With
`sections`, these are the unlabelled items above the labelled sections (a dashboard) and may be empty. Ids
are unique across `items` and `sections` (a repeated id marks two items as the current page).
Leave it out to compose the navigation as children instead.

Sidebar.name: children
Sidebar.description:
With no `items`: the navigation composed from `SidebarItem`, `SidebarSubmenu` and `SidebarSection`
(loose items first, then the sections), plus an optional `SidebarHeader` (instead of `brand`) and
`SidebarFooter` (instead of `footer`).

Sidebar.name: sections
Sidebar.description:
Labelled sections under `items`, in order. Each is a named group with an overline; collapsed,
the overline is visually hidden (the group keeps its name) and a separator stands in for it. Not
collapsible. Left out (or empty), the Sidebar renders exactly as before.

Sidebar.name: currentKey
Sidebar.description: The id of the page's item: marked `aria-current="page"`; its group stays open.

Sidebar.name: footer
Sidebar.description: The account at the bottom: name and role after `avatar` (or Avatar, name and role together). Or a `SidebarFooter` child.

Sidebar.name: avatar
Sidebar.description:
The account's Avatar before `footer`. Collapsed, the rail shows it alone, centred, and `footer` is hidden.
Without it, collapsed shows the start of `footer`.

Sidebar.name: isFooterPinned
Sidebar.description:
Keeps the account (`footer`) and the collapse toggle in view at the bottom: the brand stays at
the top and only the navigation (`items`, then `sections`) scrolls between them, expanded and
collapsed. In the phone panel the account stays at the bottom the same way. The DOM order, and so the Tab
order, is the same as without it. Off by default: the whole sidebar scrolls as one, as before.

Sidebar.name: isCollapsed
Sidebar.description: Icons only (56px), labels in tooltips. Controlled; or `defaultCollapsed` + `onCollapsedChange`.

Sidebar.name: storageKey
Sidebar.description:
Remembers the collapsed choice in localStorage under this key. Render `sidebarScript(storageKey,
{ defaultCollapsed })` in <head> as well, with the same `defaultCollapsed`, so the first frame already
has the remembered width (no layout jump). Uncontrolled only: with `isCollapsed` the app owns the state.

Sidebar.name: isMobileOpen
Sidebar.description: Under 1024px the sidebar is a menu panel from the start edge; the app's menu button opens it.

Sidebar.name: aria-label
Sidebar.description: Names the navigation landmark; "Main menu" by default.

Sidebar.name: motion
Sidebar.description: `auto` (follow the device), `reduce` or `none`, for this component; the provider's setting otherwise.

SidebarHeader.name: children
SidebarHeader.description: The product name (or the logo and name together); it links to the Sidebar's `brandHref`.

SidebarHeader.name: logo
SidebarHeader.description: The app's mark before the name; collapsed, the rail shows it alone. As the Sidebar's `logo`.

SidebarItem.name: id
SidebarItem.description: Unique in the sidebar; `currentKey` matches it.

SidebarItem.name: label
SidebarItem.description: A noun for the page ("Orders"); also the tooltip when the sidebar is collapsed.

SidebarItem.name: icon
SidebarItem.description: Lucide name; top-level items carry one (it is all a collapsed sidebar shows).

SidebarItem.name: badge
SidebarItem.description: A count ("4 new"): a Badge after the label, on the icon when collapsed.

SidebarItem.name: isCurrent
SidebarItem.description: Marks this item as the page in view, instead of the Sidebar's `currentKey`.

SidebarSubmenu.name: id
SidebarSubmenu.description: Unique in the sidebar; `currentKey` matches it.

SidebarSubmenu.name: badge
SidebarSubmenu.description: A count ("4 new"): a Badge after the label, on the icon when collapsed.

SidebarSubmenu.name: icon
SidebarSubmenu.description: Lucide name; top-level items carry one (it is all a collapsed sidebar shows).

SidebarSubmenu.name: label
SidebarSubmenu.description: A noun for the page ("Orders"); also the tooltip when the sidebar is collapsed.

SidebarSubmenu.name: children
SidebarSubmenu.description: The nested `SidebarItem`s, shown indented when it is open.

SidebarSection.name: label
SidebarSection.description: The overline over the items, already translated; it names the group, also when collapsed.

SidebarFooter.name: children
SidebarFooter.description: The account's name and role (or Avatar, name and role together).

SidebarFooter.name: avatar
SidebarFooter.description: The account's Avatar before the rest; collapsed, the rail shows it alone. As the Sidebar's `avatar`.

SidebarAccount.name: name
SidebarAccount.description: The person's name: the row's first line, the trigger's name and, collapsed, its tooltip.

SidebarAccount.name: description
SidebarAccount.description: The second line: an email or a role.

SidebarAccount.name: avatarSrc
SidebarAccount.description: A photo; the name's initials otherwise.

SidebarAccount.name: items
SidebarAccount.description: The account menu: profile, settings, sign out (a `danger` item goes last).
